CENTCOM confirmed the relocation of the Combined Joint Task Force–Operation Inherent Resolve (CJTF-OIR) to Jordan following the formal end of the coalition’s military mission in Iraq on September 30, when the last American and partner forces left Erbil Air Base.

🚨✈️ What to know about the Flydubai hijack attempt drama
It remains unclear whether the pilot who carried out the onboard stabbing intended to divert the FlyDubai aircraft to Israel, deliberately crash it, or stage a 9/11-style attack, the Jerusalem Post cites Israeli sources as saying. What is certain, they claim, is that he attempted to hijack the plane.
Authorities describe the incident as a major disaster that was only narrowly avoided.
According to the latest account:
🔴pilots of the Flydubai plane are Omani and Emirati nationals, respectively; incident may have been caused by the Omani pilot (Israel’s Channel 14)
🔴 one pilot stabbed the other, triggering a physical struggle in the cockpit
🔴 attacker then allegedly attempted to seize control of the aircraft
🔴 during the struggle, the aircraft plunged roughly 4,000 meters 
🔴 Israeli passengers and additional crew members reportedly overpowered and restrained the pilot
The Boeing 737 MAX operating Flydubai flight FZ1073 first transmitted 7700, the international code for a general emergency, followed by 7500, indicating possible hijacking or unlawful interference. Israeli fighter jets were scrambled.
The plane, carrying roughly 180 passengers, ultimately diverted to Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely. 
PM Netanyahu and Defense Minister Katz held consultations, while the IDF chief of staff met with the heads of the Shin Bet and Mossad.
